src_members.sig: public static LayerMask LayerMaskField(string label, LayerMask layerMask)
src_members.name: LayerMaskField
src_members.comment: EditorGUILayout.MaskField mangles a LayerMask's raw value (it re-indexes to only the NAMED layers), so this converts through Unity's own helpers instead of assigning the field value directly.
